faq.q: How do you deliver a site in 48 hours?
faq.a: We use a Next.js engine with per-industry templates. We adapt the structure to your brand, your texts, your services. The site is live and working by day 2.

faq.q: What if I don't have materials (photos, texts, logo)?
faq.a: We send an express guide, and if you want we can take photos for you or write professional copy at an additional cost. With materials ready, it's 48h.

faq.q: Does it work for any profession?
faq.a: Yes. Lawyers, dentists, accountants, architects, psychologists, engineers. The structure is adaptable.

faq.q: Will I show on Google within 48 hours?
faq.a: The site is indexed that same day and can appear on Google for your name. For local searches like ‘dentist Villa Morra’ the algorithm takes 2–8 weeks. We explain what to expect.
Setup (450K Gs) is paid on signature. Monthly (381K Gs) starts when the site goes to production. No fine print.

faq.q: What happens after the first month?
faq.a: You continue with the monthly that includes hosting, support, and maintenance. No setup renewal, no hidden costs.
